HoggerJourneymanCooking.name: Journeyman Cooking
HoggerJourneymanCooking.description: Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health. Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.

HoggerBonestoGnaw.name: Bones to Gnaw
HoggerBonestoGnaw.description: Loot Hoard creates a chunk of Meat when it lands. While under the effects of Meat, gain 10 Armor.

HoggerOnTheProwl.name: On The Prowl
HoggerOnTheProwl.description: Activate to gain 25 Rage over 8 seconds. Passive: You heal for 7 Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

HoggerBruteForce.name: Brute Force
HoggerBruteForce.description: Increase the range of Loot Hoard by 25% and its damage by 50%. Quest: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 2, to a maximum of 150 bonus damage. Enemy Heroes that hit terrain grant an additional 6 damage.

HoggerAggroRange.name: Aggro Range
HoggerAggroRange.description: Increase Hogg Wild's radius by 20% and each enemy hit generates 0.5 Rage, increased to 2 against Heroes.

HoggerHoggersJoggers.name: Hogger's Joggers
HoggerHoggersJoggers.description: While above 35Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received. When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.

HoggerDenseBlastingPowder.name: Dense Blasting Powder
HoggerDenseBlastingPowder.description: Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit. Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.

HoggerGarbageFire.name: Garbage Fire
HoggerGarbageFire.description: Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23 damage and are Slowed by 20%.

HoggerSeeingRed.name: Seeing Red
HoggerSeeingRed.description: While above 50 Rage, gain 35% Attack Speed and the cooldowns of Staggering Blow and Hogg Wild refresh 30% faster.

HoggerHoardapult.name: Hoardapult
HoggerHoardapult.description: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds. Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

HoggerShockwave.name: Shockwave
HoggerShockwave.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

HoggerDustDevil.name: Dust Devil
HoggerDustDevil.description: Gain 25 Armor while Hogg Wild is active and for 4 seconds after. When at or above 50 Rage, increase this Armor to 40.

HoggerPummel.name: Pummel
HoggerPummel.description: Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 30% for 2 seconds.

HoggerBloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
HoggerBloodthirst.description: Damaging Heroes with Basic Attacks, Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild heals you for 33% of the damage dealt.

HoggerHeadbanger.name: Headbanger
HoggerHeadbanger.description: Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

HoggerKablooie.name: Kablooie!
HoggerKablooie.description: Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%. Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.

HoggerFurzerker.name: Furzerker
HoggerFurzerker.description: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow or Ez-Thro Dynamite increases the damage of the next Basic Attack within 8 seconds by 50%, stacking up to 2 times. When Hogg Wild ends, gain 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

HoggerSecretStash.name: Secret Stash
HoggerSecretStash.description: Every 2 seconds, Hoardapults' Loot Hoard randomly launches Ez-Thro Dynamite, prioritizing nearby enemy Heroes. Every 5 seconds, it also launches a chunk of Meat towards Hogger.

HoggerPowerSpike.name: Power Spike
HoggerPowerSpike.description: Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage. Passive: Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.

HoggerNoControl.name: No Control
HoggerNoControl.description: Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby. Cannot be cancelled.

HoggerAngerManagement.name: Anger Management
HoggerAngerManagement.description: Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%. Passive: Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.
